{{Quote|I apologize if I appear unwelcoming--I am not accustomed to seeking help from your kind. I am left with little choice. Two Mystics and a team of Voss Commandos are missing. They are in my charge. I must find them.|Jiri-Su|<ref name="TOR:SoS"/>}}
'''Jiri-Su''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] and the mother of [[Tem-Su]] who lived during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. After the conquest, the [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Rada-Ki]] contacted the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] to see about investigating the [[Shrine of Silence]], however when the Initiative took too long to get back to her, she and Tem-Su went ahead anyway, despite her objections.<ref name="TOR:SoS"/> By [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> they were declared missing, and Jiri-Su asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to investigate the shrine for her.<ref name="TOR:SoS"/> However, the Commander was forced to kill her son and Rada-Ki as they were under the influence of the ancient [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[The Curse]].<ref name="TOR:SoS2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Shrine of Silence}}</ref>
